why: v0.19 proved AI JSON can be verified, but overlap warnings were too naive: layered video design often requires multiple tracks to overlap. The next useful step is to make verification understand product intent and teach AI to use time anchors automatically.
changed_from: Replaces the planned showcase sample generator. User clarified that multi-track overlap is normal and the real need is detecting unexpected contract violations plus a well-designed anchor system AI can reliably use.

constraints.no_vanity: 本版看得见的效果 = verify report 明确 overlap allowed，并输出 anchor_guide。
constraints.no_overreach: 本版只改 verifier 语义和 anchor guidance · 不做自动修复、不做样片生成器、不做像素 AI。
constraints.no_rush: 不把正常设计叠层误报成错误；只抓明确违背意图的时间/结构问题。
constraints.must_verify: 验收画面 = showreel 不再有 layout.overlap warning；裸数字时间反例会触发 anchor.raw-time。

success_picture: AI 看到报告后知道: 轨道可以重叠；时间必须优先用 intro/layers/code/out 这类 anchor；裸数字时间会被提醒修正。
risks: anchor guidance 只是静态契约，还没有自动改写 JSON。
overlap allowed by default 可能漏掉真的视觉遮挡，后续要用截图像素检测补上。
不同类型项目可能需要更细的 intent schema。

candidates.title: Intent-aware verifier + anchor guide
candidates.why: 直接修正 v0.19 的最大误导，并让 AI 时间编辑更稳定。

candidates.title: Auto repair overlap
candidates.why: 重叠本身不是错，自动修会破坏设计意图。

candidates.title: Pixel-based unexpected visual error detector
candidates.why: 应该做，但需要截图差分/视觉规则，适合下一版。
